newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Service Corp started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Service Corp started at buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Service Corp International at buy with a price target of $38 a share.

-- Rodman analyst Jennifer Childe said Service Corp is the nation's oldest and largest deathcare service provider, burying one of every 10 people who died in the United States in 1995. The company had 2,864 funeral homes, 335 cemeteries and 147 crematoria in the U.S. as of September 30, 1996, Childe said.
-- Service Corp also has a strong international presence, she said, with more than 1,500 homes in Canada, Australia, France and Britain.

-- Childe said Service Corp's low operating costs and high margins give it consistently strong operating results. She expects the stock to appreciate by 20 percent annually, assuming no multiple expansion.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/2 Tuesday at 30-1/8.
